title: leucanthemum visianii
intro: Leucanthemum visianii, commonly known as the Alpine Daisy, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in wound healing and skin care. The therapeutic actions of this plant include astringent, diuretic, and hemostatic properties, which may help in reducing swelling, promoting urination, and stopping bleeding. The bioactive constituents of Leucanthemum visianii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
